text.tspan: Headlight: low-side, 25 kHz PWM for dimming and strobe (22 Ω gate resistor, 12 mA pin drive). Rear lamp: shared ground, so tail, brake and turns are switched on the 12V side, fully on/off (no PWM);
the lamp runs its own breathing / brake-flash / sequential patterns. REAR_* nets leave the box on J1 (sheet 1); lamp ground sits on the GND Wago.
R6 holds the headlight off while the MCU is unpowered. TLP241A: 40 V / 2 A output, LED trigger ≤ 3 mA; set GP7–GP9 and the tail pin to 8 mA drive in firmware. Output pins 3/4 are interchangeable.
